# Kong (bookwithkong.com)

> Kong is a booking platform for tour and activity operators in Asia-Pacific. Operators take direct bookings through their own website, free for operators, with a 1.8% booking fee paid by the guest at checkout. Kong's OTA connections are in development.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.bookwithkong.com/): Kong booking platform for tour operators
- [Kong Australia](https://www.bookwithkong.com/australia): Australian pricing and details
- [Kong Malaysia](https://www.bookwithkong.com/malaysia): Malaysian pricing and details
- [About](https://www.bookwithkong.com/about): The team behind Kong
- [Compare](https://www.bookwithkong.com/compare): Kong vs other booking platforms
- [Blog](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog): Practical guides for tour operators

## Blog: Australia guides

- [What OTAs and Resellers Charge Tour Operators in Australia (2026)](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/ota-commission-rates-australia): Viator, GetYourGuide and Klook commissions, plus Australian marketplaces, trade and concierge rates, every figure sourced and dated.
- [Rezdy Pricing Explained (2026)](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/rezdy-pricing): Rezdy's plans, the 3% online fee and offline booking charges, with worked examples at Australian volumes.
- [Rezdy Alternatives for Australian Tour Operators (2026)](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/rezdy-alternatives-australia): Six alternatives compared on verified pricing: FareHarbor, Bookeo, Checkfront, Bokun, Rezgo and Kong.
- [Tour Operator Insurance in Australia](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/tour-operator-insurance-australia): Public liability, professional indemnity, marine cover and workers comp, with verified premium figures.
- [SEO for Tour Operators: The Australian Guide](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/seo-for-tour-operators): Google Business Profile, Maps rankings, reviews, tour pages and AI assistants.
- [Australia's Card Surcharge Ban: Operator Guide](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/card-surcharge-ban-tour-operators): What tour operators must change before 1 October 2026: fees, pricing and a pre-October checklist.
- [Best Tour Booking Systems in Australia (2026)](https://www.bookwithkong.com/blog/best-booking-software-australia): Honest comparison of Rezdy, FareHarbor, Bokun, Checkfront and Kong.

## Original research

- [The State of Tour Operator Bookability in Southeast Asia (2026)](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia): Only 11.8% of 2,334 tour operators across six countries can take a booking online. Original research, 43 destinations, data CC BY 4.0.
- [Singapore](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/singapore): 28.4% of operators bookable online, a census of the city.
- [Thailand](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/thailand): 17.6% bookable; Phuket 29.0%, Koh Samui 9.0%.
- [Malaysia](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/malaysia): 10.2% bookable; 40.1% have no web presence at all.
- [Vietnam](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/vietnam): 9.8% bookable despite 86.6% online presence.
- [Philippines](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/philippines): 8.4% bookable; diving is 37.9% of the sample.
- [Indonesia](https://www.bookwithkong.com/state-of-tour-operator-bookability-southeast-asia/indonesia): 8.1% bookable; 64.1% of non-bookable websites route bookings through WhatsApp.
